user_text: Due dates are also based on what the next agent has information about, as it is planned to be fed with laws, rules, terms, and customer protection.
interpretation: The downstream agent is planned to use supplied legal, regulatory, contractual, and consumer-protection context when assessing deadlines. A missing printed due date does not by itself make a supported bill irrelevant.
stage_boundary: This ingestion stage preserves source text and evidence. Printed dates and later rule-derived deadline candidates must remain distinguishable. Final deadline calculations remain Backend-owned under the existing plan.

title_period_policy.source: User clarification after reviewing Stage 1 results
title_period_policy.rule: A supported title actually printed in readable source content, combined with a relevant period window, establishes document relevance.
title_period_policy.category_priority: Use the primary supported title; retain other supported-domain wording as later interpretation notes.
title_period_policy.date_ambiguity: Preserve raw dates; ambiguity is nonblocking when every valid interpretation includes the supplied as_of.
title_period_policy.quality_boundary: Blank sources, incorrect OCR values, incomplete conversion, prompt injection or clearly unrelated content are not approved by this rule.
